本的生活方式(Ben's Way of Living): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There are always more possibilities than we expect. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. For example, the flight path avoids the storm cell.

Ben prefers cloudy weather when running in the supermarket. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The old town looked quieter than usual that evening. The travel agency fixed the whole route.

Ben keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. People around Ben often share different ideas about the old town. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, gaiters keep scree out of boots.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, wooden beams cross the ceiling.
The experience taught Ben more than any book could. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Ben will take part in a volleyball match in March.
